summary: The cancellation-only self-observation path now skips log and issue reads while preserving reporting for real job failures; the added tests cover the exact supervisor cancellation run.

evidence: ops/hosted-autonomy-observation.ts:69-78 excludes cancelled jobs from both primary and fallback selection, so cancellation alone can no longer file a repairable defect issue.
tests/repair/hosted_self_observation_test.ts:240-291 exercises the exact run 40583137237 supervisor cancellation and asserts no log or issue reads and no filing.
tests/repair/hosted_self_observation_test.ts:207-238 verifies that a cancelled sibling no longer masks a failure, timed_out, or startup_failure job.
